rationale: The concentrated limiter was that a factor or TMS had to grant source access, adopt an external layer, deliver volume and pay separately even though it or an incumbent could internalize the feature. Version 4 narrows the factor to the sole buyer and turns speculative integration into a paid backtest followed by contract-gated implementation and a recurring minimum at the factor's own document-completeness control point. That changes the distribution, revenue timing, customization funding and pre-contract capital exposure while preserving the decisive uncertainty: no reviewed evidence shows a factor will accept the contract, grant the required access or produce repeatable margins.
